title: All baselines re-run on held-out dataset E (iter 2)

data.dataset: iter_1/gen_art/gen_art_dataset_1 full_data_out.json group heldout_candidates (8507 rows, 700 sentences)
data.blind_loader: src/e_pool.py load_E(blind=True) strips 18 label keys + 4 class-structure keys

prompts.recall:
Translate this sentence into first-order logic in FOLIO notation: {text}
Return only the formula on one line, no explanation.
prompts.reformalise: Write a first-order logic formula (symbols ∀ ∃ ¬ ∧ ∨ → ↔ ⊕) for this sentence, using ONLY these predicates/constants: {sig}. Use the notation ∀x (P(x) → Q(x)). Return only the formula on one line, no explanation. Sentence: {sent}
prompts.rubric: You check whether a first-order logic formula faithfully expresses the meaning of an English sentence. Predicate and constant names may differ from the words of the sentence; logically equivalent rewritings are acceptable; judge MEANING only: quantifiers, which things are conditions vs asserted properties, negation, argument order, and whether any content is missing or added.
prompts.verbalise: Translate this first-order logic formula into one plain English sentence. Say exactly what the formula says, including odd or unnatural structure; do not fix it. Read CamelCase predicate names as words. Formula: {fol}

orientation: every metric oriented so that higher = more likely UNFAITHFUL (judges: 1-P(faithful))
unparseable_rule: LLM components are NOT called on unparseable candidates; they receive the pre-declared worst oriented score (1.0; SC eq_frac 0) and count as coverage failures in the COVERAGE view
json_fail_rule: judge_cheap: one retry, then fallback oriented score 0.5 (counted)

pools.PRIMARY: candidate_fol non-empty AND parses with labeller/fol.py AND converts to z3

label_regimes.R_AB: tier in {A,B} & final in {CORRECT,ERROR} & not reading_choice (headline)

combination_model: L2 logistic regression C=1.0, standardised within training folds, missing -> 0 + missing-indicator (src/analysis.py combo_oof logic); folds_E below; for fold k fit on labelled rows of other folds, predict ALL rows of fold k

thresholds.rule: frozen from the SCREEN (exp D results/analysis.json); judges flag if P(faithful)<0.5

new_columns.rt_embed_cos_local: exp D rt_embed_cos screen threshold (no local-verbaliser cosine existed)
new_columns.sc5_entropy: descriptive (no threshold): flag if > median screen value unavailable -> 0.5 nat
new_columns.b2_score: 90th percentile of b2_score on screen track-H CORRECT items (computed in b2_gate before any E label)
new_columns.S4: nested: within each training fold, the training-fit score quantile giving FA=0.10 on training CORRECT rows

testability.rule: >=50 CORRECT and >=50 ERROR rows and >=25 sentences per side (dataset card §3)
testability.untestable_cells: reported descriptively with sign only, never tested

frontier_frame_rule: cells {CORRECT,ERROR} x {L25,L20,EXC,CTRL} within R_AB ∩ PRIMARY ∩ E_POOL; 300 rows: 38 per cell (37 in the last 4 cells); order sha1(item_id+'frontier_v1'); <=1 row per sentence per cell and <=2 rows per sentence overall; inclusion probability = n_drawn/n_cell (IPW)
analyses: (a) AUROC/AUPRC/precision-recall-FA at frozen thresholds, tie rate; R_AB, R_A, COVERAGE, sensitivity; pooled/per stratum/long pool
(b) paired Δ vs judge_cheap_disg: cluster bootstrap + DeLong
(c) frontier vs cheap judge on the frame, unweighted + IPW, $ per call vs $0.002 gate
(d) contamination DiD GOLDSYS vs E_POOL, gold-recognition probe, MDE = 2.8 x bootstrap SE
(e) judge recall per error type at matched FA 0.10/0.20; error_type field accuracy vs majority chance
(f) complexity AUROC per bin + GEE (exchangeable, groups = sentence) judge_correct ~ z(words)+C(stratum)
(i) system-level Kendall tau-b over 13 system x variant rows (descriptive)
(j) invariance on exp D's 282 shared rewrites (B2 new, judges joined)

b2_spec.direction: mutant i even: phi TRUE & psi FALSE world; odd: phi FALSE & psi TRUE; fallback other direction
b2_spec.domain: constants + k fresh individuals, k=1..3, |D|<=4 (constants+1 if >3 constants), cap 6
b2_spec.world_solver: z3 Optimize minimising #true atoms, smallest SAT domain first
b2_spec.reader: google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite T=0, one call per item, text only (never a formula)
b2_spec.gate: balanced accuracy >= 0.85 on worlds of track-H expert-corrected formulas (40-item dev slice excluded)
b2_spec.prompt_dev: <=2 variants on a 40-item screen-H dev slice; frozen in prereg_b2.json

budget.note: the run-shared OpenRouter key had $0.00 left at freeze (see key_state); F-KEY applies if it dies

departures: frame drawing reads labels (disclosed; nothing tuned on it)
pilot 'documents' are artificial (system|variant, stratum, sha1 bucket of ~20 sentences) groups
rerun-Jaccard: zero-shot vs few-shot for Llama-3.3-70B/Qwen3-235B, cross-system for the rest
R_ADJ/R_COMP labels do not exist yet: exported feature table + fit_s4_oof
B2 is new: reader gate before fusion
judges not run on unparseable rows (worst score)
matched-FA recall uses per-judge E thresholds (descriptive)
disguise_item called with its default seed (seed = text), as the sibling experiment does

label_vectors.note: lines 'metadata_item_id:label' over ROWS (the 115 colliding item_ids appear once per row); '_rowkey' variant uses row_key (item_id~variant for colliding rows)

freeze_context: Frozen before ANY score file exists. The only label read before scoring is stage 'frame' (draw_frontier_frame logic in method.py), which reads item_id, final_label, tier, reading_choice, source_stratum and sentence_id to draw the 300-row frontier frame and hash the R_AB/R_A label vectors; no parameter, prompt, threshold or model choice depends on it.
